Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride is a social and road group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It meets every Thursday, meet 6:00 pm, roll 6:30 pm, starting at Angry Catfish Bicycle + Coffee Bar. Expect about 15 miles, social pace, 10–15 mph.

About the Angry Catfish Thursday FTW Social Ride group ride

A weekly ride for femme, trans and women riders only. About 15 miles at a talking pace, route varies. Starts and ends at the shop's coffee bar. Ride details go out on the shop's Discord and Instagram.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
